title: How Much Does IV Therapy Cost in Cabo? 2026 Price Guide
description: IV therapy in Cabo costs $159–$189.99 + tax at your hotel or villa, $129–$159 at a clinic, and $119 per person for groups of 6+. What's included and how to save.
h1: How much does IV therapy cost in Cabo? (2026 price guide)
image_alt: Nurse preparing a sterile single-use IV set in Cabo

intro: If you are planning a trip to Los Cabos — or waking up in one after a big night — you probably want to know one thing first: how much is an IV drip? Many providers in Cabo only tell you the price when the nurse arrives. Here are our real 2026 prices, what is included, and how to pay less.

sections.h2: Cabo IV therapy prices at a glance
list: At your hotel, villa, Airbnb or yacht: $159 to $189.99 USD + tax, depending on the drip
At our downtown Cabo San Lucas clinic: $129 to $159 USD + tax
Groups of 6 or more: $119 USD per person, tax included
p_after: See every drip side by side on our prices page.

list: Rapid Hydration — $159 + tax at your door, $129 at the clinic
Hangover Rescue — $189.99 + tax at your door, $159 at the clinic
Myers Cocktail — $189.99 + tax at your door, $159 at the clinic
Immunity Armor — $179.99 + tax at your door, $149 at the clinic
Energy & B12 — $179.99 + tax at your door, $149 at the clinic
Performance & Recovery — $179.99 + tax at your door, $149 at the clinic
Beauty Glow — $179.99 + tax at your door, $149 at the clinic

sections.h2: What is included in the price
list: A licensed nurse from a COFEPRIS-licensed team (authorization #05-022-B)
Sealed, medical-grade ingredients and a sterile, single-use IV set
The nurse visit to your hotel, villa or yacht — typical arrival 30–45 minutes
About 45–60 minutes with the nurse beside you while the drip runs
An itemized invoice in English and USD for travel insurance
p_after: Nothing is charged before the visit, and the total is confirmed on WhatsApp before the nurse heads out.

p: Bachelorette parties, weddings and villa groups of 6 or more pay $119 per person, tax included — up to about $70 less per person than individual mobile pricing. Details on our group IV page.
If you are near downtown Cabo San Lucas, the same drips are $30 less at our clinic on Francisco I. Madero, Centro.
If you mainly need fluids, Rapid Hydration ($159) is the simplest option. Hangover Rescue adds anti-nausea support; Myers Cocktail adds a fuller vitamin and mineral blend.

sections.h2: Is IV therapy covered by insurance?
p: Wellness IV drips are usually paid out of pocket. If a doctor prescribes IV fluids for an illness such as dehydration from a stomach bug, many travel medical insurance plans reimburse it — keep the itemized invoice. We do not bill insurers directly.

sections.h2: Red flags when comparing IV providers in Cabo
list: No price until the nurse arrives
Large cancellation penalties or payment required in advance
No visible license or authorization number
Reused or unsealed supplies — every set should be opened in front of you

faq.q: How much is a hangover IV in Cabo?
faq.a: Our Hangover Rescue IV is $189.99 USD plus tax at your hotel or villa, or $159 plus tax at our downtown clinic. Groups of 6 or more pay $119 per person, tax included.

faq.q: Is there a travel fee for IV therapy in Cabo?
faq.a: Our at-your-door prices include the nurse visit. We confirm the full total on WhatsApp before the nurse heads out, and there is no payment in advance.

faq.q: Can I pay in US dollars?
faq.a: Yes. Prices are in USD and we accept credit and debit cards, US dollars cash and Mexican pesos.

faq.q: How long does an IV take?
faq.a: About 45 to 60 minutes from setup to finish. Typical arrival is 30 to 45 minutes in Cabo San Lucas.
